comment: The one authored source for the check inventory (#791, part of epic #697).
Held to the shipped workflow and CLI by checks.inventory.inventory_drift: every
`gate`, `jobs` and `command` value here is compared against the gates input's
accepted values, the workflow's job names, and the CLI's leaf commands. Job names
are stored exactly as the workflow writes them, matrix template included, so the
comparison is a string equality with no normalization step to get wrong.

checks.name: colocated-test
checks.runs: every event, when the repository has sources for a static language

checks.name: one-function-per-file
checks.runs: every event, when the repository has sources for a static language

checks.name: unit-lint
checks.runs: every event, when the repository has sources for a static language

checks.name: unit-coverage
checks.runs: whole tree on every event; the same floor over the diff on pull requests only

checks.name: mutation
checks.runs: pull requests only, over the diff

checks.name: integration-lint
checks.runs: every event, when the repository has integration sources

checks.name: e2e-verify
checks.runs: pull requests only, when the repository keeps attestations

checks.name: packaging
jobs: Packaging (no test files in the built artifact)
checks.runs: every event, when a built artifact is configured or detected

checks.name: changelog
checks.runs: pull requests only, when the repository keeps fragment directories

checks.name: workflow-lint
jobs: Workflow lint (no logic in CI YAML)

jobs_without_a_check.why: computes the language matrix every other job fans out over; runs no check

commands_without_a_job.name: install
commands_without_a_job.why: writes the testing contract into the repository's agent context file

commands_without_a_job.name: e2e attest
commands_without_a_job.why: author-side: runs the e2e command and commits the branch's receipt

commands_without_a_job.name: e2e slug
commands_without_a_job.why: author-side: prints the receipt slug for a branch name
